scripts.build: cargo build --workspace --release && OUT_DIR="${KAI_HOME:-${TOOLS_HOME:-$HOME/.tools}/kai}" && mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR" && TMP_BIN="$OUT_DIR/kai.tmp.$$" && cp target/release/kai "$TMP_BIN" && mv "$TMP_BIN" "$OUT_DIR/kai"
scripts.util:biome: bunx @biomejs/biome check --write AGENTS.md package.json biome.json commitlint.config.js lint-staged.config.js
scripts.util:check: STATUS=0; bun run util:biome || STATUS=1; bun run util:format || STATUS=1; bun run util:lint || STATUS=1; bun run util:types || STATUS=1; bun run util:test || STATUS=1; bun run build || STATUS=1; exit $STATUS
